how: We read the website of every San Diego wedding videographer listed on Lazo (102 listings, 80 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Florida-based multi-state studio, national chains with a San Diego landing page, a hair and makeup team and a wedding DJ that landed in this category. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is the ceremony audio recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera, and how do you handle wind on the coast?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
Is there an hourly cap, and what happens if the reception runs late?

picks.name: Analog Cabin Films
picks.blurb: Rob has made wedding videos for a living for over 10 years and runs Analog Cabin Films as a very small team out of Cardiff. Cinematic video, Super 8 film and drone footage for weddings and elopements in San Diego, Joshua Tree and Palm Springs, with sample packages published on the site.

picks.name: Ryan Green Films
picks.blurb: Ryan Green filmed a friend's wedding in 2012 and turned a lifelong love of cinema into a full-time career. He limits himself to 25 weddings a year so each film gets attention, and the site posts how many 2027 spots remain.

picks.name: Astray Photography - Oceanside Wedding photographer & Videographer
picks.blurb: Astray's Brittney and Andy shoot timeless, documentary-style photography and videography as one North County team, with over a decade of experience and more than a thousand love stories behind them. One vision across both services.

picks.name: Focused Bliss Productions
picks.blurb: Focused Bliss is Michael's cinematic wedding filmmaking company, built on emotionally driven storytelling from quiet glances and raw moments rather than staged ones. Films for couples celebrating in California and destinations worldwide.

picks.name: Odom Media LLC
picks.blurb: Mike Odom is a born-and-raised San Diegan with 15 years in photography and 8 in professional videography, offering a full-service photo and video package of candid stills, cinematic films and highlight reels. Based in San Diego and available for travel worldwide.

picks.name: Good Thing Media
picks.blurb: Lalo and Minnie are a husband-and-wife duo in Chula Vista who moved from business videos to wedding films. Good Thing Media prints its packages: $2,500 buys six hours, one videographer and a four-to-five-minute film with an eight-week turnaround, and $3,200 buys eight hours.

picks.name: Leggacy Films
picks.blurb: Trevor Legg learned the trade filming weddings with his dad's company, Video Reflections, and took over the editing in college. Seven years into his own documentary-style films, with an hour-long documentary edit offered as an add-on.

picks.name: Side by Side Cinema
picks.blurb: Jared and Danielle film and edit everything themselves, a husband-and-wife team with over 10 years in the field and 7 years of weddings. Every Side by Side Cinema package includes two cinematographers, cinematic editing and six months of backup storage, with prices between $3,100 and $3,800 printed on the site.

picks.name: Mpro productions
picks.blurb: Frank and his wife Mary have worked behind the camera together since their marriage in 2012, treating photography and film as a responsibility rather than a product. Mpro Productions in Spring Valley says it crafts visual stories, not photos or videos.

picks.name: Alphares Studio
picks.blurb: Twelve years and hundreds of events, with every price posted: Alphares Studio lets you pick a package or build your own crew, hours and add-ons and see the price instantly. Photo and video packages start at $2,500, and the team replies within 24 hours.

picks.name: Chasing Light Photo & Film
picks.blurb: Chasing Light is Russ and Clara in Oceanside, bringing over 15 years of photo and video experience and a pitch aimed at adventurous couples. They say their strength is authenticity and teamwork across weddings, engagements and elopements.

picks.name: PKA Photo & Video
picks.blurb: A husband-and-wife team that started PKA Photo & Video in June 2022 after their own wedding visuals disappointed them, and has since captured over 300 weddings and events. The promise is complete transparency, no surprise fees, and every photo and video delivered.
